title: Ned and the Shy Earwig
note: b418 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about earwigs.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling standing on tiptoes looking at a small reddish-brown earwig on top of a grey stone wall.
A close-up of a reddish-brown earwig showing two thin, curved pincers at the tip of its tail.
Ned the duckling leaning in close and calm, looking at the curved pincers of an earwig.
A reddish-brown earwig tucked into a narrow dark crack between two grey stones in a wall.
A reddish-brown earwig emerging from a crack in a stone wall under a dark night sky with a bright moon.
A reddish-brown earwig nibbling at a piece of old, soft, curling green leaf on the ground.
A reddish-brown earwig close to a tiny insect on a grey stone wall.
A clear side view of a whole reddish-brown earwig resting on the flat top of a grey stone wall.
Ned the duckling watching as a reddish-brown earwig slips back into a narrow crack in a stone wall.
Ned the duckling standing by a grey stone wall, looking pleased, the tip of an earwig just visible in a crack behind him.
